question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"opened."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "Open" means to move something or part of something so that it is no longer closed; to move so as to be no longer closed. (किसी बंद वस्‍तु (दरवाजे़ आदि) को खोलना; खोलने के लिए खिसकाना)

 
 
• **Example**: *This window will not open.__*
 
 
 
• **"Opened"** is the correct past tense form of the verb **"open"** to fill in the blank.
 
• The sentence is in the past tense, so it requires a verb form that indicates a past action.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• **Correct passage**:

He __**opened**__ his eyes. Moonlight was shining ______ (2) ______ the bars on the window. And ______ (3) _______ was goggling through the ______ (4) ______ at him: a freckle-faced, red-haired, long-nosed someone. Ron Weasley was outside Harry's ______ (5) _______.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Expanded"** means to increase in size or scope. (फैलना या फैलाना)
 
• **"Close"** means to shut or block access to something. (बंद करना या होना)
